data.name: AppDescription
data.value: Draw end profiles, modules and hall plans for model railway module meetings.

data.name: NoDrafts
data.value: There is no work in progress.

data.name: SaveReminder
data.value: Drafts are kept only in this browser. Save your work to a file.

data.name: PickAgain
data.value: This browser can't re-open files by itself. Use Open… and pick {0}.

data.name: FileNotAvailable
data.value: {0} isn't available any more. Use Open… to pick it.

data.name: DownloadNote
data.value: This browser can't save in place: Save downloads a new file. Choose the old file to replace it.

data.name: DraftNotFound
data.value: This drawing isn't open any more.

data.name: EditorComing
data.value: This is a read-only view. The editor for this kind of drawing comes in a later version.

data.name: StorageError
data.value: The browser's storage couldn't be used: {0}

data.name: IsEndewender
data.value: Endewender (the asymmetric end profile changes side)

data.name: DrawnWithNotes
data.value: The module was drawn. Check these notes:

data.name: ModuleIdentificationHelp
data.value: Modules are identified by the owner's prefix and a number, e.g. SFjä 0012, as in FREMO, or by a name. Give a number with the prefix, a name, or both.

data.name: PackageLabelHelp
data.value: The box the module is transported in. Give the modules of one box the same label.

data.name: ModuleOwnersHelp
data.value: Optional: the names of the owners, separated by commas. Uploading to the Module Registry fills them in or replaces them.

data.name: ModuleProblem_NameMissing
data.value: Enter a name, or a number with the prefix.

data.name: ModuleProblem_PrefixMissing
data.value: Enter the prefix with the number.

data.name: AngleRange
data.value: {0} must be greater than 0 and at most 360.

data.name: CatalogueIntro
data.value: Standards, add-ons and end profiles. The built-in entries come with the app; your own entries are kept in this browser and can be exported as a file.

data.name: NoEndProfilesFound
data.value: The files contain no end profiles.

data.name: ImportChoiceNote
data.value: Ticked profiles are added to your catalogue. A profile that differs replaces the one in the catalogue, keeping its id, so modules that use it get the imported drawing.

data.name: ConfirmRestoreBuiltIn
data.value: Remove your version of {0} and use the built-in one again?

data.name: UpdateFailed
data.value: The update was postponed because your work couldn't be stored: {0}

data.name: NoOverrides
data.value: There are no overrides. Joints are classified by the rules alone.

data.name: OverrideIntro
data.value: An override replaces the rule result for one pair of end profiles, for known exceptions. Use it only where the rules give the wrong answer.

data.name: EditBuiltInNote
data.value: This entry is built in. Saving it creates your own version, which replaces the built-in one until you restore it.

data.name: Problem_ScaleUnknown
data.value: {0}: choose a scale from the catalogue.

data.name: Problem_EndProfileNotOfStandard
data.value: {0}: choose an end profile of this standard.

data.name: Problem_TrackColorInvalid
data.value: {0} must be a colour such as #1f5fbf.

data.name: Problem_BaseStandardUnknown
data.value: {0}: choose a standard from the catalogue.

data.name: Problem_EndProfileUnknown
data.value: {0}: choose an end profile from the catalogue.

data.name: Problem_SameEndProfile
data.value: {0} must differ from the first end profile.

data.name: Problem_DifferentScales
data.value: {0} must be of the same scale as the first end profile.

data.name: Problem_OverrideExists
data.value: {0}: there already is an override for these end profiles.

data.name: SandboxIntro
data.value: A test drawing for the editor: click or drag a rubber band to select, drag to move (Shift: straight, Alt: no snapping), Ctrl+Z to undo. Pan with the middle button or Space + drag, zoom with the wheel or a pinch.

data.name: PathHelpDrawing
data.value: Click to add points; click the start to close, Enter to finish, Backspace to undo a point, Escape to cancel.

data.name: DimensionHelp
data.value: Click two points, then where the dimension line goes.

data.name: NewEndProfileIntro
data.value: Start from a rectangular end profile with tracks; then draw the outline, ground line and screw holes in the editor.

data.name: PlateEdgesOrder
data.value: The bottom edge must be further below rail top than the top edge.

data.name: TrackCountRange
data.value: The number of tracks must be 0–8.

data.name: OutlineHelp
data.value: Click the corners of the end profile; click the first corner to close it. The new outline replaces the old one.

data.name: GroundLineHelp
data.value: Click the points of the landscape surface from left to right; press Enter to finish. It replaces the old ground line.

data.name: ScrewHoleHelp
data.value: Click where a screw hole goes; it snaps to edges, other holes and the grid.

data.name: TrackHelp
data.value: Click where a track goes; its rail top is always at the rail-top line.

data.name: EndProfileSelectHelp
data.value: Click to select, drag to move (Shift: straight, Alt: no snapping), Delete to remove. Seen from outside the module.

data.name: EndProfilesUpdated
data.value: Updated from your catalogue: {0}. Save the module to keep the change in its file.

data.name: UpperEdgeHelp
data.value: Click the points of the end profile's upper edge from left to right; press Enter to finish. The sides follow the first and last points.

data.name: UpperEdgeHelpDrawing
data.value: Click to add points; Enter finishes, Backspace removes a point, Escape cancels.

data.name: PlateHelp
data.value: The upper edge is also the ground line compared at joints. Drag the points in the drawing or type them in mm; Y is negative below rail top.

data.name: UserNameHelp
data.value: Recorded with the date in the revision log of each drawing you save, to show who made changes.

data.name: CountryHelp
data.value: Standards that apply only in some countries, such as MMM in Sweden, are offered only when you choose one of those countries; their add-ons and end profiles likewise. Drawings that use them open as usual.

data.name: ApiKeyHelp
data.value: Only needed to use the Module Registry API. It is kept in this browser and never saved in drawings or catalogue files.

data.name: CountriesHelp
data.value: Two-letter country codes, e.g. SE, separated by commas. Empty: the standard applies in all countries.

data.name: Problem_CountryInvalid
data.value: {0}: use two-letter country codes such as SE.

data.name: Problem_GaugesMissing
data.value: {0}: a standard needs at least one gauge.

data.name: Problem_GaugeRepeated
data.value: {0}: the narrow gauge must differ from the normal gauge.

data.name: NoRevisions
data.value: Not saved by anyone with a user name yet.

data.name: Warning_NoUserName
data.value: No user name in the settings: when you save a drawing, it is not recorded in the revision log.

data.name: ScaleHelp
data.value: Only standards and end profiles of this scale are offered, with their add-ons. Module Registry requests will also ask for this scale.

data.name: NewHallIntro
data.value: Start from a rectangular hall; then add pillars, furniture, doors, emergency exits and no-go zones in the editor, or draw other walls.

data.name: HallSelectHelp
data.value: Click to select, drag to move (Shift: straight, Alt: without snapping), Delete to remove. Drag a corner or a wall to reshape the hall; doors follow their wall.

data.name: HallWallsHelp
data.value: Click the corners of the walls and click the first corner again to close them. The new walls replace the old ones.

data.name: HallAreaHelpDrawing
data.value: Click to add corners; click the first corner to close. Backspace removes a corner, Escape cancels.

data.name: HallFurnitureHelp
data.value: Click the corners of the furniture, e.g. a stage or a counter, and click the first corner again to close it.

data.name: HallNoGoHelp
data.value: Click the corners of an area where nothing may be placed, e.g. in front of a fire hose cabinet, and click the first corner again to close it.

data.name: HallPillarHelp
data.value: Click where the centre of the pillar is; change its size in the properties.

data.name: HallDoorHelp
data.value: Click on a wall where the door is. The area in front of it must be kept free.

data.name: WallsHelp
data.value: Measures in metres; you can also type e.g. 450 mm. A new length moves the corner where the wall ends. An arc other than 0° makes the wall curved.

data.name: MinimumAisleWidthHelp
data.value: 0 uses the minimum clearance of the hall plan's standard.

data.name: IsModuleEntrance
data.value: Modules can be carried in and out here

data.name: DoorPositionHelp
data.value: Measured along the wall to the edges of the opening, as shown in the drawing.

data.name: StoragePersisted
data.value: The browser keeps your settings and drafts. They are removed only if you clear the browser's data for this site.

data.name: StorageNotPersisted
data.value: The browser may remove your settings and drafts, e.g. when disk space runs low or the site hasn't been used for a while. Save your drawings to files.

data.name: StorageAskToKeep
data.value: Ask the browser to keep them

data.name: StorageRefused
data.value: The browser didn't agree. Some browsers agree only after the site has been used for a while, or when it is installed as an app.

data.name: KeepDataTitle
data.value: How to make {0} keep your data

data.name: SettingsFileHelp
data.value: Export your settings and language to a file, and import them again if the browser has forgotten them, or in another browser. The file contains your Module Registry API key: keep it to yourself.

data.name: SettingsFileInvalid
data.value: {0} isn't a Module Draw settings file.

data.name: ModuleSelectHelp
data.value: Click a section joint or one of its points to select it; drag to move it (Shift: straight, Alt: without snapping). The ends stay on the module's edge. Delete removes the selection.

data.name: ModuleJointHelp
data.value: Click where the module is divided: a straight joint is added across the track there. Escape returns to Select.

data.name: JointDistance
data.value: Distance from the start along the track

data.name: JointPointsHelp
data.value: Type the points' positions, or drag them in the drawing. A new point is added after the selected one; move it to make the joint bend. The ends stay on the module's edge.

data.name: SectionsHelp
data.value: A module of several sections is divided by section joints. Choose Section joint and click where the module is divided, then select the joint to set its exact position. Joints between sections always fit.

data.name: NoOutlineForSections
data.value: This module has no outline to divide into sections.

data.name: NoHelpYet
data.value: There is no help for this page yet.

data.name: KeepFreeDepthHelp
data.value: How far into the hall the area in front of the door must be kept free.

data.name: RotationHelp
data.value: How far the pillar is turned counter-clockwise, in degrees.

data.name: WallLengthHelp
data.value: A new length moves the corner where the wall ends.

data.name: JointDistanceHelp
data.value: Where the joint crosses the track, measured along the track from the module's first end.

data.name: EndProfileShortNameHelp
data.value: Written along the module end in module drawings, e.g. B96. Without it, the designation is used.

data.name: FlipEndHelp
data.value: Turn the end plate the other side out, so that the asymmetric end profile's high side is on the other side of the track.

data.name: CannotRedraw
data.value: This module wasn't drawn from a template, so its end profiles and curve can't be changed here; its ends can still be flipped.

data.name: BendsWillChange
data.value: The tracks of an end profile are off the centre of the end plate, so the bends of the section joints will move relative to the tracks. Check the joints afterwards. Continue?

data.name: TrackLengthHelp
data.value: The length a train can use. At a turnout the track ends where a train on the other track can still pass, not at the points.

data.name: TracksHelp
data.value: Add the tracks that trains are planned on, and say which track each track element is part of. Every module has at least one track: a through track or a track ending.

data.name: NoTrackElements
data.value: This module has no track elements.

data.name: LocationNone
data.value: This module is plain line: it has no name in the timetable, and trains pass it.

data.name: LocationRemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove the operation location, with its name, signature and properties? The tracks stay.

data.name: LocationHelp
data.value: The operation location is what a timetable planner sees of the module: where trains stop, meet or are routed. Its tracks are in the Tracks pane.

data.name: LocationSignatureHelp
data.value: The short name used in timetables, e.g. Tby. It is unique within the country.

data.name: LocationCountryHelp
data.value: The country the location is operated as part of, as a code of two letters, e.g. SE.

data.name: LocationKeyRequired
data.value: A key is needed for the turnouts

data.name: LocationCentreMiddle
data.value: Centre in the middle of the module

data.name: LocationCentreHelp
data.value: Distances to other locations are measured from the centre, e.g. the station building, along the main track.

data.name: LocationKindChangeConfirm
data.value: A {0} can't have: {1}. Change the kind and clear it?

data.name: LocationProblem_NameMissing
data.value: The operation location has no name.

data.name: LocationProblem_SignatureMissing
data.value: The operation location has no signature.

data.name: LocationProblem_CountryCodeInvalid
data.value: The country is a code of two capital letters, e.g. SE.

data.name: LocationProblem_CentreNegative
data.value: The centre can't be before the left end.

data.name: LocationProblem_ShadowNotAllowed
data.value: Only a station can be a shadow station.

data.name: LocationProblem_TurntableNotAllowed
data.value: Only a station can have a turntable.

data.name: LocationProblem_PassengerExchangeNotAllowed
data.value: Passengers can't be exchanged at this kind of location.

data.name: LocationProblem_CargoExchangeNotAllowed
data.value: Cargo can't be exchanged at this kind of location.

data.name: LocationProblem_PassengerExchangeRequired
data.value: Passengers are always exchanged at a shadow station.

data.name: LocationProblem_DirectionChangeNotAllowed
data.value: Trains can't change direction at this kind of location.

data.name: LocationProblem_TrainsCrossingNotAllowed
data.value: Trains can't cross at this kind of location.

data.name: TrackProblem_NoTracks
data.value: The module has no track in the list. Every module has at least one: a through track or a track ending.

data.name: TrackProblem_DesignationNotUnique
data.value: More than one track is called {0}.

data.name: TrackProblem_UnknownTrack
data.value: Track element {0} is part of a track that isn't in the list.

data.name: TrackProblem_ElementWithoutTrack
data.value: Track element {0} is part of no track.

data.name: TrackProblem_TrackWithoutElements
data.value: Track {0} has no track elements, so its length isn't known.

data.name: TrackProblem_ScheduledTrackReachesNoExit
data.value: Track {0} is scheduled, but no end of the module can be reached from it.

data.name: Field_FoulingDistance
data.value: Track distance where trains pass freely (mm)
